title: CG Flood Response 2009 Day 1
description: This video features rescue footage from the Jan. 7, 2009 rescue of Morton, Wash. residents who were stranded due to the Pacific Northwest Floods and interviews with the Coast Guard Air Station Astoria pilots who performed the rescue. (Official Coast Guard video for release, video production by Chief Petty Officer Russ Tippets)
